properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 19 at 9:20AM EST until November 19 at 11:15AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
FFWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Brevard County in east central Florida...
Southeastern Orange County in east central Florida...

* Until 1115 AM EST.

* At 920 AM EST, emergency management reported a road closure on SR
520, near the SR 528 interchange. Between 2 and 5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Wedgefield, Christmas, Lone Cabbage Fish Camp and Bithlo.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
